message.content: In most cases, a **sword** is the recommended choice when facing a dragon in *DragonSlayer*. If you’re playing at a higher level and have access to more powerful weapons, you might consider upgrading to a legendary sword or a specialized dragon‑bane weapon. For ranged play, a longbow or crossbow can also be effective, especially if you want to keep your distance.
